title: fix(print): a print with no filename names the PDF from the record's display name
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_
Fixes #35049

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi4PechTRCTBrfxV8W

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在记录上点"打印"生成的 PDF 附件，现在以记录的标题命名（比如报价单号），不再是"页面名-记录编号"这种看不懂的名字；应用自己指定了文件名的照旧。
- 为兄弟应用 HotCRM 解决：打印报价单得到的附件名看不出是哪张报价单。
- 记录没有标题时仍沿用旧名字；同一条记录打印两次会得到两个同名附件，互不覆盖；改动可直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`printRecordToFile` (and so `POST /api/v1/print/records`) archived every PDF without an explicit `filename` as `PAGE-RECORDID.pdf`. Seat route (the card's second option): the default is now the record's display name (ADR-0079) plus `.pdf`. No template key, no spec change, no new authorable key.

- **Where the name comes from.** Step 4 already read the record AS THE CALLER and threw the row away; it now returns that row (`readAsCaller`, was `refuseUnlessReadable`), and the name is built from it, so there is no second read and the name never shows a value the caller may not read. The title field is `resolveDisplayField` (`@objectstack/spec/data`, the field `resolveRecordDisplayName` reads) over `engine.registry.getObject(object)`, the same registry the files opt-in reads.
- **Fallback.** No title field, an empty value, a value the caller's field-level security leaves out of the row, a value that is not text or a finite number, or one empty once made safe keeps the old `PAGE-RECORDID.pdf`. The `Record #ID` floor of `resolveRecordDisplayName` is deliberately not used, so no file is named `Record #…`.
- **Hygiene** (`safeFileBase`). Control characters become a space; path and reserved characters (slash, backslash, colon, asterisk, question mark, double quote, less-than, greater-than, pipe) become `_`; whitespace runs collapse; leading dots and spaces go (no hidden file, no `..`); a trailing `.pdf` is not doubled; the name is cut to 100 characters (code points, never inside a surrogate pair) with trailing dots and spaces dropped after the cut. The attachment service has no sanitiser to reuse: `attachFileAs` stores the name as given, keys the bytes by the file id (`buildKey`), and the download header encodes it (`contentDispositionValue`). The cap matters because `sys_attachment.file_name` is `maxLength: 255`, and a longer name would be refused only after the render.
- **Explicit `filename`** is used exactly as given, unchanged.

**Visible change:** a print with no explicit filename now attaches `DISPLAY-NAME.pdf` instead of `PAGE-RECORDID.pdf` (stated in the changeset too).

## Tests

- `print-service.test.ts`, new top-level `describe` "the default file name": display name used, read once, with the caller's own context; derived title field (no `nameField`); explicit filename wins unchanged; five fallback cases (no title field, blank, field absent from the caller's row, non-text value, nothing left after sanitising) keep `invoice_print-inv_1.pdf`; a number display value; reserved and control characters; leading dots and a trailing `.pdf`; the 100-character cut never splits a character.
- Dogfood (real showcase boot, real storage): `print-service-archive` now pins `INV-PRINT-OWN.pdf`, and a new case prints one invoice twice. Both carry the same name, have different `sys_file` and `sys_attachment` ids, both attachments are listed under that name and both files are `committed`. That is the collision measurement: the store neither refuses nor overwrites. `print-service-named-page` now pins the project's display name.
- `vitest.config.ts`: an anchored alias for `@objectstack/spec/data` so the tests run the source, not `dist/` (`check:test-source-alias` flagged the new import).

<details><summary>Local runs (head 4d45f050)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-print test` then `typecheck`, under the verify lock on 4d45f050: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 8 passed (8), Tests 131 passed (131). The typecheck program compiles all 8 test files (`tsc --listFiles`).
- Ablation (one, on the tested behaviour), via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the default return was replaced by the old id-based name. The anchor went x1 to x0 and the blob 33627bb2 to eaeb6879. Result: 6 failed, 56 passed in `print-service.test.ts`: every display-name case went red, and the fallback and explicit-name cases stayed green, as they should. Restored: blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Dogfood, the two touched files only, after building the dogfood closure (`pnpm --filter '@objectstack/dogfood^...' build`, service-print resolved through its rebuilt `dist/`), on c8ec5395: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 2 passed (2), Tests 16 passed (16). The full battery was not run locally: the title carries no `!` and there is no narrowing arm. It is the merge queue's.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates --commands`): 98 derived. 96 were run with exit 0 (94 on c8ec5395; on 4d45f050 the re-run `check:test-source-alias` and the two `check-console-intercept-disarm` rows the alias commit added). `check:skill-examples` first answered exit 3 and was re-run green after building the client SDK. `--ran`: "98 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 96 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED". The NOT MEASURED pair are `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` (the fixture needs an unshallowed clone, checker health only) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full build). Both are left to CI.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Metadata-protocol `none`, measured.** No `packages/spec` file is in the diff. The `filename` request field lives on `PrintRecordRequest` in this service, not in any spec schema (`git grep` for a print `filename` under `packages/spec/src`: 0 hits). What an author can write is unchanged; the output of an existing print changes. Clause-② `no`: no exported type or option changes shape. Only the TSDoc of `PrintRecordRequest.filename` is reworded.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/ui/print-pages.mdx` showed `invoice_document-inv_1.pdf` as the result. It now shows the display-name result and states the default, the fallback, the hygiene and the two-prints behaviour.
- **Files outside the claimed surface:** the two dogfood files (their pins asserted the old default and would red the merge queue's dogfood shards; the collision measurement rides in one of them) and `service-print/vitest.config.ts` (the test-source-alias gate).

## Verification

Read first (by risk): `print-service.ts` `defaultPrintFilename` and `safeFileBase`; `print-service.ts` `readAsCaller` (the row returned is the caller's own read); `print-service-archive.dogfood.test.ts` "a second print of the same invoice".

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-print exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/print-service.test.ts`. Expect 62 passed, including the 12 under "the default file name".
